description: Career Intelligence endpoints: add all missing handlers to careerIntelligenceController.js and wire them into careerIntelligenceRoutes.js. Covers Tasks B, C, E (opportunity-cost), H, I. Depends on FEAT-001 (SkillEvidence model and calculateConfidence must exist).
steps: MODIFY backend/controllers/careerIntelligenceController.js — add requires at top: const SkillEvidence = require('../models/SkillEvidence'); const Internship = require('../models/Internship'); const Application = require('../models/Application'); const { calculateConfidence } = require('./skillEvidenceController'); (Note: calculateConfidence is exported as a named export from skillEvidenceController — make sure FEAT-001 exports it). Keep all existing handlers untouched.

ADD getSkillGapPriority handler to careerIntelligenceController.js: GET /skill-gap-priority. Load all SkillEvidence for req.user.id. Load AIStudentProfile for learningRoadmap. Get all Internship docs (status active/published), build a skill→demandCount map by counting appearances in requiredSkills arrays. For each SkillEvidence doc: gapScore = 100 - confidenceScore (min 0). demandCount = skillDemandMap[skillName] || 0. Determine priority: if (gapScore > 60 && demandCount > 5) → 'high'; else if (gapScore > 30 || demandCount > 2) → 'medium'; else → 'low'. estimatedImpact: high→'Unlocks many opportunities', medium→'Moderate impact', low→'Minor improvement'. learningEffort: gapScore>60→'high', gapScore>30→'medium', else→'low'. reason: string describing the gap. Sort by: high first, then medium, then low, then by gapScore desc within each group. Return array of objects.

ADD getWhatIfSimulation handler to careerIntelligenceController.js: POST /what-if. Body: {skill, improvementPoints: Number}. Load SkillEvidence for that skill and user. currentConfidence = doc?.confidenceScore || 0. simulatedConfidence = Math.min(100, currentConfidence + (improvementPoints || 20)). Query Internships (active/published). For each internship, look at requiredSkills array. currentOpportunities = count of internships where currentConfidence >= 50 (simple threshold) AND skill is in requiredSkills. estimatedAfter = count where simulatedConfidence >= 50 AND skill in requiredSkills. delta = estimatedAfter - currentOpportunities. Return {currentOpportunities, estimatedAfter, delta, skill, currentConfidence, simulatedConfidence, disclaimer: 'This is an estimate, not a guarantee'}.

ADD getOpportunityUnlock handler to careerIntelligenceController.js: GET /opportunity-unlock?skill=X. Query Internship.find({'requiredSkills': {$regex: new RegExp(skill, 'i')}}) or use $in after normalising. Count matching internships. Get distinct categories from matching internships. estimatedUnlock = internships where user does NOT currently have SkillEvidence.confidenceScore >= 50. Return {skill, internshipsRequiring: count, categories: string[], estimatedUnlock: number}.

ADD getWhyNotApply handler to careerIntelligenceController.js: GET /why-not-apply/:internshipId. Load Internship by id (404 if not found). Load all SkillEvidence for user. For each skill in internship.requiredSkills (or skills): find user evidence. userConfidence = evidenceDoc?.confidenceScore || 0. severity: userConfidence < 30 → 'high'; userConfidence < 60 → 'medium'; userConfidence < 80 → 'low'; else skip (no concern). concern: {skill, userConfidence, required: skill, severity, suggestion: 'Build evidence for this skill via projects or assessments'}. overallRisk: if any high severity → 'high'; else if any medium → 'medium'; else → 'low'. Return {concerns, overallRisk, internshipTitle: internship.title, recommendation: overallRisk==='high' ? 'We recommend improving key skills before applying.' : 'You are a reasonable candidate. Consider applying.'}.

ADD getCounterfactualRecommendation handler to careerIntelligenceController.js: POST /counterfactual. Body: {questionType: 'smallest_improvement'|'best_skill'|'best_project'}. Load SkillEvidence and AIStudentProfile for user. Load all Internships. Build skillDemandMap. Cases: 'best_skill' → find the skill in internship requiredSkills that the user has NO evidence for (or lowest confidence) AND has highest demandCount. Return {recommendation: skillName, reasoning: 'Appears in X internships', estimatedImpact: 'Could unlock up to X new opportunities', disclaimer: 'This is an estimate'}. 'smallest_improvement' → For each skill in SkillEvidence, find distance to nearest threshold (40, 60, 80). Pick skill with smallest distance that would unlock >0 new internships. Return same shape. 'best_project' → find top 3 in-demand skills user lacks. Return {recommendation: 'Build a project covering: [skills]', reasoning, estimatedImpact, disclaimer}.

ADD getExplainableRecommendation handler to careerIntelligenceController.js: GET /explain/:internshipId. Load Internship (404 if missing). Load SkillEvidence for user. const required = internship.requiredSkills || internship.skills || []. matched = required skills where user has SkillEvidence.confidenceScore > 40. missing = required skills where user has no evidence OR confidenceScore <= 40. fitScore = required.length > 0 ? Math.round(matched.length / required.length * 100) : 0. reasons = matched.map(s => `You have evidence for ${s}`). warnings = missing.map(s => `No or low evidence for ${s}`). Return {matchedSkills: matched, missingSkills: missing, fitScore, reasons, warnings, internshipTitle: internship.title}.

ADD rankApplicationsByValue (opportunity-cost) handler to careerIntelligenceController.js: GET /opportunity-cost. Load Application.find({student: req.user.id, status: 'Applied'}).populate('internship'). For each application: load SkillEvidence for user, compute fitScore = matchedSkills/requiredSkills*100. qualityScore from internship (use calculateQualityScore logic inline or import from internshipQualityController — import {calculateQualityScore} from './internshipQualityController'). urgency = Math.min(100, daysSinceApplied / 30 * 100). compositeScore = fitScore*0.4 + qualityScore*0.4 + urgency*0.2. Rank: compositeScore>75→'A', 50-75→'B', else→'C'. Return sorted array with opportunityCostRank field.

MODIFY backend/routes/careerIntelligenceRoutes.js — import all new handlers. Add routes: GET /skill-gap-priority → getSkillGapPriority; POST /what-if → getWhatIfSimulation; GET /opportunity-unlock → getOpportunityUnlock; GET /why-not-apply/:internshipId → getWhyNotApply; POST /counterfactual → getCounterfactualRecommendation; GET /explain/:internshipId → getExplainableRecommendation; GET /opportunity-cost → rankApplicationsByValue. All protected.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/career-intelligence/skill-gap-priority returns array (possibly empty) with no crash
POST /api/career-intelligence/what-if with {skill:'React', improvementPoints:20} returns {currentOpportunities, estimatedAfter, delta, disclaimer}
GET /api/career-intelligence/why-not-apply/:internshipId returns {concerns, overallRisk, recommendation} or 404 for unknown id
POST /api/career-intelligence/counterfactual with {questionType:'best_skill'} returns {recommendation, reasoning, estimatedImpact, disclaimer}
GET /api/career-intelligence/explain/:internshipId returns {matchedSkills, missingSkills, fitScore, reasons, warnings}
GET /api/career-intelligence/opportunity-cost returns sorted array with opportunityCostRank field
verification: cd backend && node server.js — must start without errors
Postman/curl: GET /api/career-intelligence/skill-gap-priority (with auth token) — must return HTTP 200
Postman/curl: POST /api/career-intelligence/counterfactual body {questionType:'best_skill'} — must return HTTP 200 with disclaimer field
findings: All 7 new handlers added to careerIntelligenceController.js and wired in careerIntelligenceRoutes.js. Imports added: SkillEvidence, Internship, calculateConfidence (from skillEvidenceController), calculateQualityScore (from internshipQualityController). All existing handlers preserved unchanged. Server starts cleanly (node process confirmed running). Committed as 567e91c. Note: calculateConfidence import is present but not used directly in this controller — it was required per the spec; actual confidence data is read from stored confidenceScore fields on SkillEvidence docs.
